finishedText: A home visit was conducted on 12/11 and was attended by Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea. The visit identified that mould in the back bedroom has returned and is worse by the window. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea stated that the landlord has not replied to two emails. A letter was observed on the table. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes missed the benefits form deadline, and her date of birth on the form is 3/3/87. It was agreed during the visit that the worker will ring the landlord on Monday, and Maria Okonkwo-Reyes will post the form on Friday. In addition, Tomas Brandvold, who is a neighbour and also on the worker's list, offered to help her with the form. The identified risk is potential rent arrears if the form is late. The next step is to revisit 26/11.
